name: Knockback
describe: Blasts throw every body near them (ragdolls, tumbling creatures, loose props); the host simulates each flight and every screen plays the same one
examples: a blast throws everyone near it flying
explosions send ragdolls tumbling into the sea
a bomb bowls over a row of crates

radius.description: Reach of a blast that names none (m)

force.description: Speed a blast gives a body of mass 1 at its centre (m/s)

up.description: How far a blast tips its push upward (0 straight out, 1 about 45°)

falloff.description: How a blast weakens toward its edge

damage.description: Damage at a blast's centre, passed to the health mechanic (0: blasts only throw)

bounce.description: Speed a body keeps off a hard landing (0 thud, 1 rubber)

friction.description: Sliding speed a body keeps per bounce

settle.description: Seconds a body lies still after it stops, before it gets up

chain.description: A body thrown fast knocks the bodies it passes

chainSpeed.description: Slowest a thrown body knocks another (m/s)

chainShare.description: Share of its speed a thrown body passes on

masses.description: Mass per body kind (humanoid, blob, worm, quadruped, flyer, prop): heavier flies less far

props.description: Names of the world's scenery props that are loose: a blast throws them too

fromProjectile.description: A projectile splash (splashRadius > 0) throws through this part, not the projectile's own knock

creditSeconds.description: Seconds a thrown player still counts as thrown by whoever threw them (kb.lastHitBy)

juice.description: Shake, hitstop and slow motion sized by each blast and landing (ctx.juice, within the player's comfort settings)

landFx.description: A vfx preset where a body lands hard (dust-kick, smoke-puff, ...); unset: the effect style's hit, or none

splashFx.description: A vfx preset where a body falls into the sea (water-splash); unset: none

sound.description: A sound id when a body is thrown; unset: none

landSound.description: A sound id when a body lands hard; unset: none

splashSound.description: A sound id when a body falls into the sea; unset: none

templates.label: Shake and slow motion on big hits

events.name: onBlast
events.args: { at, radius, force, from, bodies (host: [{ key, player, v, k }]) }

events.name: onFling
events.args: { body, kind: 'player' | 'prop', player, v, from, duration, into }
events.when: a body was thrown (into: rest | water | out): the flight is its answer on every screen

events.name: onLand
events.when: a thrown body hit the ground hard

events.name: onSplash
events.when: a thrown body fell into the sea

events.name: onSettle
events.when: a thrown body came to rest

host.how: the host simulates each flight once against the world and sends the whole path; every copy plays it from when it arrived (the owner's capsule rides it, every copy steers the ragdoll onto it); moved props are in the shared state for late copies

fields.o: { propKey: [x, y, z, angle, axisX, axisZ] } loose props a blast moved

bots: no bot code (blasts throw bots as they throw players)

lines: Nothing throws by itself but a projectile splash (fromProjectile): rules or another part call kb.blast(at, { radius, force, from }) on the host.
A thrown player is down for the flight and the settle; fair play refuses a throw on a player who is down or protected. Score in onFling or onSplash (from: who threw them), on the host.
kb.lastHitBy(p) says who threw a player within creditSeconds: the hazards mechanic credits a fall into the sea with it.

stub.worked: kb.onSplash(e => { if (ctx.host && e.from && e.player && e.from !== e.player) e.from.score += 3; });
traps: kb.blast and kb.fling act on the host only: keep them under if (ctx.host)
a projectile splash already blasts through here (fromProjectile): calling kb.blast in onHit too throws everyone twice

signs: checked: gate C (measure 15) judges its sign of life (sample and judge in the implementation)
